Mute timings are scheduling rules that define time intervals during which alert notifications should be suppressed, such as during maintenance windows or outside business hours. This GET endpoint at /v1/provisioning/mute-timings returns the complete collection of mute timing configurations, allowing administrators to view when and under what conditions notifications will be automatically silenced. The response typically includes details like timing names, time intervals, days of the week, months, and any other temporal constraints that have been defined for each mute timing rule.
